items.source: Be sure to also use N1qlPrimaryIndexed to make sure the PRIMARY INDEX is there as well.
items.translation: 同时，请确保使用N1qlPrimaryIndexed来确认主索引也已存在。

items.source:
Said index will relate to the "type" field (the one bearing type information) and restrict on documents that match
the repository's entity class.
items.translation: 该索引将与“type”字段（即承载类型信息的字段）相关联，并限制为匹配存储库实体类的文档。

items.source: This annotation is targeted at Repository interfaces, indicating that the framework should ensure a N1QL Secondary Index is present when the repository is instantiated.
items.translation: 此注解针对 Repository 接口，指示框架在实例化仓库时应确保存在 N1QL 二级索引。
